findings.title: Authoring model lacks phaseType field
findings.detail: AuthoringPhase has id and title but no phaseType. The Convex phase_versions table and the renderer's PhaseRendererProps both require phaseType: PhaseType ('explore' | 'vocabulary' | 'learn' | 'key_concept' | 'worked_example' | 'guided_practice' | 'independent_practice' | 'assessment' | 'discourse' | 'reflection'). Phase 2 persistence must either extend the authoring model or require phaseType as input during the flatten-and-persist step.
findings.impact: Phase 2 'Convex draft lifecycle' task must define the phaseType mapping. No fix needed in Phase 1 — phaseType selection belongs in the Phase 2/3 composer UI.

findings.title: displayName not in authoring model
findings.detail: The Convex activities table requires displayName: v.string(), but AuthoringActivity does not include displayName. Phase 2 persistence must generate a display name (e.g. from componentKey + section context) or require it as input.
findings.impact: Phase 2 task must define how displayName is derived. No fix needed in Phase 1 — displayName is a persistence-layer concern.

findings.title: Section structure divergence between authoring model and renderer
findings.detail: AuthoringSection uses markdown?: string, callout?: string, activities: AuthoringActivity[]. The renderer's PhaseSection uses a discriminated union: { sectionType: 'text', content: { markdown } } | { sectionType: 'callout', content: { variant, text } } | { sectionType: 'activity', content: { componentKey, activityId } }. Phase 2 persistence must flatten the authoring model's section structure into the renderer's discriminated union format.
findings.impact: Phase 2 'flatten and persist' task must define this mapping. No fix needed in Phase 1 — the authoring model is the teacher-facing abstraction.

findings.title: No explicit validation-then-normalization ordering contract
findings.detail: normalizeLessonDraft validates structure but not props schemas. validateActivityConfig validates props schemas. These must be called in order: normalize → validate each activity → sanitize → persist. The Phase 2 implementation must enforce this ordering; currently there is no explicit contract or integration test composing the full pipeline.
findings.impact: Phase 2 'Convex draft lifecycle' task must define the orchestration order. No fix needed in Phase 1 — the separation is by design for testability.

findings.title: No integration test for full normalize→validate→sanitize pipeline
findings.detail: Phase 1 tests cover each module independently. There is no integration test that composes normalizeLessonDraft → validateActivityConfig → sanitizeLessonDraft on a single draft. This is acceptable for Phase 1 scope but should be added in Phase 2 or 3 when the pipeline is wired together.

findings.title: SanitizedText renders as plain text only
findings.detail: SanitizedText uses React.createElement(Tag, {}, safe) which renders sanitized text as a plain text node. Authored markdown formatting (bold, italic, headings) is preserved in the string but not rendered as HTML. For Phase 3 preview, the composer UI will likely need a markdown-aware renderer (e.g. the existing LessonMarkdownRenderer) instead of SanitizedText for section content.
findings.impact: Phase 3 composer UI must use a markdown renderer for preview, not SanitizedText. SanitizedText is correct for inline error messages and status text. No fix needed in Phase 1.

findings.title: gradingConfig and standardId not in authoring model
findings.detail: The Convex activities table includes gradingConfig (optional) and standardId (optional), but AuthoringActivity does not include these fields. Phase 2/3 must decide whether grading config and standard alignment are authorable or system-generated.
findings.impact: Phase 2 design decision. No fix needed in Phase 1.
